mapper.insert: INSERT INTO capability_invocation (incident_id, investigation_id, run_no, capability_key, managed_resource_id, status, request_schema_name, request_schema_version, request_payload, started_at, correlation_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{i.incidentId}, #{i.investigationId}, #{i.runNo}, #{i.capabilityKey}, #{i.managedResourceId}, 'RUNNING', #{i.requestSchemaName}, #{i.requestSchemaVersion}, #{i.requestPayload}, #{i.startedAt}, #{i.correlationId}, #{i.startedAt}, #{i.startedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT incident_id FROM capability_invocation WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id FROM capability_invocation WHERE incident_id = #{incidentId} AND investigation_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 'RUNNING' ORDER BY id
SELECT id, incident_id, investigation_id, recovery_verification_id, run_no, capability_key, managed_resource_id, status, started_at FROM capability_invocation WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE capability_invocation SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', response_schema_name = #{responseSchemaName}, response_schema_version = #{responseSchemaVersion}, response_payload = #{responsePayload}, raw_result_ref = #{rawResultRef}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, updated_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE capability_invocation SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, updated_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
